name: 空間周波数時間解析
description: Analyzes spatial 周波数 temporal stability
algorithm: Spatial Freq Temporal — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes the temporal behavior of spatial frequency content across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **Per-Frame空間的周波数分解**: Each frame is decomposed into spatial frequency bands via 2D FFT or wavelet transform. The energy at each spatial frequency is tracked over time, creating a 3D representation (spatial frequency × orientation × time).

2. **周波数安定性分析**: For static regions, the spatial frequency content should remain stable across frames. The method measures temporal variance at each spatial frequency. Deepfake generation may produce temporally varying frequency content — particularly at high frequencies where generation artifacts fluctuate frame-to-frame.

3. **顔-Background周波数コヒーレンス**: The temporal behavior of spatial frequencies in face regions vs. background should be similar (same imaging pipeline). The method compares temporal frequency stability between regions. Different temporal stability characteristics indicate different generation/capture sources.

4. **スペクトルFlicker検出**: The method detects temporal oscillations in specific spatial frequency bands. These "spectral flickers" can arise from: (a) GAN training instabilities producing oscillating artifacts, (b) autoencoder quantization varying between frames, (c) frame-rate conversion creating frequency-domain beating patterns.

5. **NaturalImageStatistics時間的一貫性**: Natural images follow the 1/f spatial frequency power spectrum (scale invariance). This relationship should hold consistently across frames. The method tracks the spectral slope over time — systematic temporal variations in the 1/f exponent indicate processing artifacts from AI generation.
parameters:
分析タイプ: 周波数
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through spatial freq temporal analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
